Ming Xi brought over the late-night snack, not interrupting his work. She personally held the bowl, feeding him one spoonful of food and one of congee at a time.

Xie Pei lifted his gaze and gave her a gentle smile. Whatever Ming Xi fed him, he ate, his attention remaining on the memorial in his hands.

After he finished his meal, Ming Xi prepared to go to sleep.

The two of them were very comfortable together, one without airs, the other not forcing herself. They paid no mind to the rigid rules between a crown prince and his concubine.

Ming Xi didn’t have to force herself to stay awake, propped up in a chair, just to wait for him.

He wouldn’t have liked that anyway.

“Has Your Highness finished his work?”

Ming Xi came out from the washroom to see the Crown Prince changing into his nightclothes.

Drowsy, she walked over, groggily wrapping her arms around his lean, powerful waist, and rubbed her cheek against his well-built chest.

*Such a handsome man, truly wonderful!*

It was a shame that in her past life, she had been so weak, barely clinging to life. Even with money, she hadn’t had the strength to enjoy such pleasures.

Otherwise, she would have kept ten or eight handsome men of all kinds.

That would have been an unimaginable happiness.

In this life, she had the means, but her ambitions were too great.

Between power and beauty, Ming Xi had chosen power without hesitation.

She had thought that while the Crown Prince was handsome, he was public property, and she could only satisfy herself occasionally.

She hadn’t expected the Crown Prince to have a brain solely focused on love, especially toward her.

As for the future, Ming Xi decided to enjoy the present first.

Xie Pei’s body tensed as she rubbed against him. He reached out to hold her waist, his voice slightly hoarse. “I’m done. Are you very tired?”

Ming Xi looked up, her beautiful eyes shimmering with a smile, as if her entire heart and mind were filled with only him.

“I was tired, but holding Your Highness makes me so happy that I’m not tired anymore.”

Xie Pei: “…”

His heart truly couldn’t take it!

How could there be such an adorable and charming girl in this world?

The Crown Prince stroked her hair, his smile full of indulgence. “You can hold me. I only let Xi’er hold me.”

The girl curved her eyes in a smile and continued rubbing against his chest. “Your Highness is the best.”

When she rubbed against a particularly sensitive spot, Xie Pei sharply inhaled. He quickly bent down, picked her up horizontally, and gave her nose a light kiss. “Be good. It’s late. Time to sleep.”

Ming Xi barely managed to hold back her laughter and nodded obediently at him.

The two embraced as they lay in bed, whispering softly to each other.

Ming Xi wasn’t lying when she said she wasn’t tired.

She really wasn’t sleepy anymore.

Xie Pei also enjoyed their intimate late-night conversations. “Tomorrow, when you go to the palace, don’t be afraid. Just treat it as a stroll.”

With the cold weather, the news of Concubine Feng pushing Consort Shi into the lake had spread throughout the palace, inside and out.

In the afternoon, the chief eunuch from the Empress’s side came to deliver an oral decree: the two concubines and four consorts of the Eastern Palace were to enter the palace together the next day for an audience.

Concubine Feng’s arrogance had finally become too much for the Emperor and Empress to bear, so they decided to summon everyone for a scolding.

“I’m not afraid. I have Your Highness.”

Ming Xi smiled at him with trust and reliance.

“Xi’er…”

Xie Pei’s Adam’s apple bobbed as he couldn’t resist lowering his head to gently press his lips against hers.

Ming Xi softly wrapped her arms around him, submissively allowing him to kiss her. She wouldn’t have minded if he went further.

However, the Crown Prince was a man of principle.

Xie Pei restrained himself, burying his face in her neck to steady his breathing.

“Xi’er, grow up quickly.”

Ming Xi: “…”

There was nothing she could do about that, so she changed the subject. “Your Highness, do you dislike Consort Shi?”

Xie Pei tightened his hold on her. “Apart from Xi’er, I dislike everyone.”

Ming Xi pouted at him. “Your Highness, we’re talking about serious matters!”

The Crown Prince felt wronged, he was only telling the truth.

Ming Xi found it amusing. Well, this peculiar Crown Prince had always treated the women of the harem as if they were enemies.

Sometimes, Ming Xi even wondered, who was the real Crown Prince?

How could he be more enthusiastic about infighting than she was?

As they talked, Ming Xi didn’t realize when she had fallen asleep.

Xie Pei gazed intently at her sweet sleeping face, silently smiling.

Xiao Ming Zhu and Feng Yuerong, he would make sure they died without a proper burial.

And as for Shi Yue?

Xie Pei’s eyes darkened with cold intent. In his past life, that woman had never been a peaceful one.

On the surface, she appeared as gentle as a chrysanthemum, but in reality, she was a troublemaker, always stirring up trouble and causing problems for Xi’er.

Later, when Prince Qi’s faction rebelled, she had without hesitation knelt before Xie Yi, slandering and cursing Xi’er in every way possible, hoping to ingratiate herself with the traitors and save her own life.

Long before the Emperor had arranged the marriage, Xie Pei had ordered people to closely monitor Shi Yue and the others. Naturally, he hadn’t overlooked her unusual behavior.

He hadn’t expected that woman to have reincarnated as well.

But Xie Pei didn’t take her seriously.

Could a fool, even after reincarnation, possibly have a different brain?

He had only ordered people to keep a close watch on her every move.

He deliberately let the Eastern Palace know of his dislike for Shi Yue. Apart from not wanting her to have an easy time, he also wanted her and Feng Yuerong to fight, step by step pushing them into hell.

Xie Pei gently stroked the small face of the person in his arms, cherishing her warmth.

He had already been twisted beyond recognition in his past life.

Especially when it came to her, Xie Pei was even more obsessive.

Anyone who had harmed her deserved no good end.

chapters.title: Things Have Escalated
chapters.content:
"Your Majesty the Empress, this concubine greets you. May you be blessed with eternal fortune."

Ming Xi and Consort Feng knelt on either side at the front, leading the four Good Ladies in bowing to the Empress.

The Empress looked at the delicate, flower-like young women below her and felt an intense dislike rise in her heart.

They were all a bunch of little vixens seducing the Crown Prince.

After a while, when Ming Xi and the others' knees were nearly numb from kneeling, the Empress twitched the corner of her mouth. "Rise."

"Thank you, Your Majesty the Empress."

The Empress did not grant them seats. Instead, she scrutinized them with a stern gaze.

"These days, I have been well aware of the disturbances in the Eastern Palace. His Majesty selected you to enter the palace to serve the Crown Prince and ensure the continuation of the imperial lineage, not to seduce and beguile His Highness, stir up trouble, and disrupt the peace of both the palace and the court!"

The six women panicked and knelt again.

"This concubine is terrified. Please forgive me, Your Majesty the Empress."

Ming Xi lowered her head, her heart aching for her knees, while Feng Yuerong beside her had a face as pale as paper.

She knew that today's matter was directed at her.

But she was truly wronged!

Was it her fault that the Crown Prince favored her?

It was all because of that vicious woman, Shi Yuan.

Though Shi Yuan was the "victim," the unease and guilt in her heart were no less than Feng Yuerong's.

She had been too hasty!

But Feng Yuerong had gone too far.

"You only know to plead for forgiveness now. What were you doing before? Each and every one of you is restless."

The Empress berated them for nearly half an hour, spittle flying, before allowing Ming Xi and the four Good Ladies to stand. She ordered Consort Feng to remain kneeling.

"Feng, do you admit your guilt?"

Feng Yuerong's eyes reddened. "Your Majesty, this concubine is truly wronged. This concubine did not push Shi Yuan into the water!"

The Empress sneered. "At this point, you still refuse to repent. Could it be that Shi Yuan jumped into the lake herself?"

Feng Yuerong stiffened her neck. "She did jump in herself!"

"Nonsense! You are utterly stubborn and unrepentant!"

The Empress launched into a fierce tirade against Feng Yuerong, cursing her so thoroughly that even the Feng family was reduced to nothing in her words.

Ming Xi and the four Good Ladies all minimized their presence, acting like quails.

Sigh, if even the husband wasn't the emperor, he would still be weak.

But Ming Xi would never be so foolish as to go to Feng Yuerong's lengths.

Feng Yuerong had always taken pride in her family, especially admiring her grandfather. She always felt that the Feng family was the purest and most noble, with unmatched integrity.

Now that the Empress had so humiliated her and the Feng family, Feng Yuerong could no longer bear it.

"Your Majesty, you accuse this concubine without distinguishing right from wrong and belittle the Feng family. This concubine cannot accept it. Even if this concubine must shatter into a thousand pieces, I will prove the innocence of the Feng family and myself!"

Feng Yuerong, crying, rushed toward a nearby pillar, intending to crash into it.

Not to mention the Empress, even Ming Xi was startled.

Was this the "leisurely stroll in the palace" that a certain Crown Prince had mentioned?

The Empress was so shocked that she stood up, her hands trembling. "Why haven't you called for the imperial physicians yet!"

She had only wanted to suppress and control Consort Feng today, not to drive her to death!

"Your Majesty! Look, Consort Feng is bleeding!"

At the palace maid's exclamation, everyone saw fresh blood slowly seeping from beneath Consort Feng. The Empress's vision went black.

Things had escalated!

...

The incident of Consort Feng crashing into a pillar in the Empress's palace to prove her innocence, resulting in a miscarriage, had even alarmed the Emperor.

As soon as court was dismissed, His Majesty hurried to Jingren Palace with the Crown Prince.

They saw basin after basin of bloody water being carried out from the side hall.

The Empress, along with Ming Xi and the others, stood in the corridor, waiting anxiously.

The imperial physician rushed out and knelt on the ground. "Reporting to Your Majesty the Empress, Consort Feng has lost too much blood. The child in her womb cannot be saved."

"How dare you! Did I not order you to do everything to save Consort Feng's child?"

"Your Majesty, please forgive this lowly one!"

"You useless quacks..."

"Do you have the time to blame the imperial physicians? Why didn't you restrain your own arrogance earlier?"

The Emperor's cold voice rang out.

Everyone was startled and quickly bowed in respect.

The Emperor lowered his head, looking coldly at the pale-faced Empress. "Feng is your daughter-in-law. If she has done wrong, you can naturally discipline her. But why must you drive her to death?"

"Your Majesty, please forgive me! This concubine truly did not intend to drive Feng to her death. This concubine only..."

The Empress cried out in injustice.

She was no fool. What good would come from driving the Crown Prince's consort to death in her own palace?

"If you didn't, then why did she crash into the pillar?"

"This concubine... this concubine doesn't know!"

While the Emperor was reprimanding the Empress, the Crown Prince seemed still immersed in the heavy blow of losing "his child" and couldn't recover.

In reality, as soon as a certain prince entered Jingren Palace, all his attention was on that pure white figure.

It had started snowing that morning. Before going out, Ming Xi had chosen a pure white fox fur cloak. The fluffy collar framed her small, delicate face. From afar, as she looked at him, her bright eyes were as clear as water, charming and lovely.

The cold wind blew the white fur, as if it was stirring his heart. Xie Pei wished he could rush forward and hold her in his arms.

Ming Xi secretly glanced at him, extending a fair finger from her cloak and waving it at him.

Xie Pei almost lost his composure at his little wife's cuteness, using all his acting skills to maintain his grieving expression.

Jingren Palace was crowded with people, so Ming Xi didn't dare to be too bold. After playfully greeting the Crown Prince, she retreated back to the corner and lowered her head.

The Emperor severely reprimanded the Empress before asking the imperial physician about Consort Feng's condition.

The imperial physician repeated the same words: Consort Feng's child could not be saved, and she herself was seriously injured and would need careful care in the future.

The Emperor sighed and ordered the imperial physicians to spare no expense in treating Consort Feng.

"A great man need not worry about lacking a wife or children. Do not be too heartbroken."

The Emperor patted the Crown Prince's shoulder in comfort.

Xie Pei said with grief, "It is this son's lack of filial piety that has caused Your Majesty to worry."

"Crown Prince..." the Empress began, but hesitated, fearing that the Crown Prince would distance himself from her.

This was absolutely not what she wanted.

Xie Pei bowed to the Empress. "Mother, this son knows that this matter is not your fault!"

The Empress was moved to tears, wiping them with her handkerchief. "If I had known her temper was so fierce, I would never have scolded her. It pains me greatly that you have lost a child."

Xie Pei said, "Mother, you speak too seriously. It is all Feng's fault for not knowing her place."

Only then did the Empress feel a slight relief in her heart.

A mere consort could not compare to her, the Empress Dowager.

As long as the Crown Prince had filial piety, it would not be in vain that she had raised him.

Ming Xi watched this grand performance with cold eyes.

She had long known what the Empress was truly like.

Today it was Consort Feng who was a thorn in the Empress's eye; tomorrow, it might be her.

Now that things had come to this, once the Crown Prince ascended the throne, there would be plenty of drama in the harem.

But Ming Xi was unafraid.

Moreover, with today's events, the Empress's days ahead would not be so comfortable.

A mother who had driven the Crown Prince's consort to crash into a pillar, causing the loss of the Crown Prince's "first child," would in the future, if the new emperor showed any signs of disrespect, lead the court officials to first suspect whether the Empress Dowager had done something that outraged heaven and humanity.

The Empress was destined to be at a disadvantage before the Crown Prince in the future.

---
